name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes the behavior (paint a portrait sprite frame into the dialog portrait slot). No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed by decompilation and caller context (fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step drives it with mouth-cycle frame indices).
purpose: Blit one portrait sprite frame into the active dialog portrait slot, choosing a normal or horizontally-mirrored blit depending on which portrait slot (left vs right-side ally) is active.
logic_summary: Computes sprite_addr = data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buffer + offset_table[frame], where the offset table is the array of int32 offsets at the head of the active DATO.DAT portrait buffer (indexed by frame). If data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset != 0x9017, calls fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal(0xA0000 + offset, sprite_addr, 0x140) (normal blit into the left/standard slot). Otherwise (0x9017 = right-side ally slot) calls fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_mirrored(0xA9017, sprite_addr, 0x140) for a horizontally-flipped blit. 0x140 (320) is the VGA mode-13h destination pitch.

params.name: frame
params.semantics: Index into the per-frame sprite-offset table at the head of data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buffer (the active DATO.DAT portrait entry); selects which mouth-cycle sprite frame to draw. Caller fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step passes the 0/1/2/1 mouth-open/close cycle values.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects its role as the sprite frame index; ASCII; no address residue.
